shortDescription.ar: The center integrates several interconnected medical functions:
shortDescription.en: The center integrates several interconnected medical functions:

description.ar: The Cardiac & Internal Medicine Center is a comprehensive, multidisciplinary hub at INSAN designed to manage complex internal medicine cases, cardiac emergencies, and critical care referrals. Operating across Future Specialized Hospital and Delta International Hospital, it provides a seamless continuum of care from outpatient clinics to highly specialized intensive care units.
description.en: The Cardiac & Internal Medicine Center is a comprehensive, multidisciplinary hub at INSAN designed to manage complex internal medicine cases, cardiac emergencies, and critical care referrals. Operating across Future Specialized Hospital and Delta International Hospital, it provides a seamless continuum of care from outpatient clinics to highly specialized intensive care units.

title.ar: **Comprehensive Clinics:** Covering all major internal medicine sub-specialties.
title.en: **Comprehensive Clinics:** Covering all major internal medicine sub-specialties.

title.ar: **Advanced Diagnostics:** Ultrasound, Echocardiography, Stress Echo, CT (Future, soon at Delta).
title.en: **Advanced Diagnostics:** Ultrasound, Echocardiography, Stress Echo, CT (Future, soon at Delta).

title.ar: **ICU Life Support:** Patient monitors, CRRT (Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy), Infusion pumps, Ventilators, CPAP for respiratory failure, and Dialysis.
title.en: **ICU Life Support:** Patient monitors, CRRT (Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy), Infusion pumps, Ventilators, CPAP for respiratory failure, and Dialysis.

title.ar: **Logistics:** 24/7 Emergency Room, Home visits, and Ambulance (at Future).
title.en: **Logistics:** 24/7 Emergency Room, Home visits, and Ambulance (at Future).

content.ar:
The center integrates several interconnected medical functions:
*   **Outpatient Clinics:** Including General Internal Medicine, Hepatology (الكبد), Endocrinology (الغدد الصماء), Nephrology (الكلى), Pulmonology (الصدر), Neurology (مخ وأعصاب), and Geriatrics (طب مسنين).
*   **Inpatient & Critical Care Beds:** A dynamic capacity of Inpatient wards (داخلي), Intermediate Care (رعاية متوسطة), and Intensive Care (رعاية مركزة). Bed assignment is strictly based on the treating consultant's medical decision.
*   **Diagnostic Capabilities:** Comprehensive laboratory and radiology services including Ultrasound, Echocardiography (Echo), Stress Echo, and CT Scans (available at Future, with Delta receiving a CT in 3 months).
*   **Emergency & Mobile Care:** 24/7 Emergency response, Home Medical Services, and fully equipped Ambulance services (currently based at Future).
*   **External Network:** While Cath Labs (diagnostic, therapeutic, and cerebral) are not physically inside the hospitals yet, the center maintains direct, 24/7 contracts with premier specialized centers. Professors and consultants are available around the clock for both elective procedures and emergency interventions.

description.ar: The Women's & Children's Health Center at Delta International Hospital is a specialized, comprehensive hub providing integrated care for women across all stages of life. From normal and high-risk pregnancy follow-ups to complex gynecological surgeries, the center offers a seamless continuum of care under the supervision of university professors and PhD-holding consultants.
description.en: The Women's & Children's Health Center at Delta International Hospital is a specialized, comprehensive hub providing integrated care for women across all stages of life. From normal and high-risk pregnancy follow-ups to complex gynecological surgeries, the center offers a seamless continuum of care under the supervision of university professors and PhD-holding consultants.

content.ar:
An integrated women's healthcare platform offering diagnostic, therapeutic, and surgical services. Key services include:
*   Normal and high-risk pregnancy management (including twins).
*   Normal and Cesarean deliveries.
*   Fetal monitoring (Sonar and Doppler).
*   Diagnostic and therapeutic gynecological endoscopy.
*   Surgical removal of the uterus, fibroids, and ovarian cysts.
*   Treatment for endometriosis, urinary incontinence, and menstrual disorders.
*   Postpartum care and family planning clinics.
*   Neonatal incubators and care.

description.ar: The Urology & Andrology Surgery Center provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic services for all diseases affecting the kidneys, ureters, bladder, prostate, and urethra. It also specializes in andrology and male infertility surgeries, offering medical, endoscopic, laser, and traditional surgical treatments based on individualized patient assessment.
description.en: The Urology & Andrology Surgery Center provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic services for all diseases affecting the kidneys, ureters, bladder, prostate, and urethra. It also specializes in andrology and male infertility surgeries, offering medical, endoscopic, laser, and traditional surgical treatments based on individualized patient assessment.

content.ar:
A specialized surgical and medical center handling:
*   Endoscopic and laser lithotripsy for kidney and ureteral stones.
*   Endoscopic and laser prostatectomy (and treatment of BPH).
*   Treatment of urethral strictures.
*   Excision of bladder and kidney tumors.
*   Andrology surgeries: Varicocele, undescended testicle, hydrocele.
*   Male infertility treatments.
*   Urinary incontinence surgeries.
*   Pediatric urology (undescended testicles, complicated circumcision, urethral stricture, urinary reflux, congenital defects).
